name: Taliparamba

queries.query: Taliparamba Kerala official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhoomi Kerala survey map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Kerala's Directorate of Survey and Land Records, the Ente Bhoomi integrated land-information portal, the official eMaps/Bhu-Naksha cadastral viewer, and an official Taliparamba Village Office page. The public material evidences a local/state cadastral service and parcel-map workflow, but no anonymous Taliparamba parcel feature response was exposed.

queries.result: Malayalam first-party discovery returned Kerala Ente Bhoomi/eMaps material describing digital land records, real-time land parcel maps, survey-record services, and the Taliparamba resurvey office. No safe anonymous parcel geometry or stable native parcel identity was returned.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Government of Kerala Directorate of Survey and Land Records / Revenue, Survey and Registration departments; Taliparamba Superintendent Survey and Land Records (Resurvey) office is listed in the Kerala government service directory.
officialSourceAssessment.localRegistryOrProcedure: Kerala eMaps/Bhu-Naksha is the official cadastral-map workflow, with search labels for block, survey and subdivision details. Ente Bhoomi describes integrated land records and real-time land parcel maps. The official Revenue portal lists Taliparamba Village Office in Taliparamba municipality and taluk.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Bhu-Naksha page was discovered and its public UI described parcel-map search by block, survey number and subdivision. A direct anonymous curl request could not be completed because TLS verification rejected the host's expired certificate; the certificate was not bypassed. No geometry request was attempted through an untrusted connection.

Anonymous Ente Bhoomi survey portal loaded. It exposed official digital-survey, survey-record and land-parcel-map descriptions and listed village/service material, but no bounded ID-plus-geometry response for Taliparamba was returned.

The official discovery result exposed the search workflow requiring district, taluk, village, block code, survey number and a visual challenge. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, owner lookup, or unsafe field request was attempted.
Official Revenue portal identified Taliparamba Village Office, Kannur district, Taliparamba taluk and municipality. This is custodian/procedure evidence, not parcel geometry.
Kerala government directory listed Superintendent Survey and Land Records (Resurvey) Taliparamba. No parcel schema or geometry was provided.
